asks: Does the model answer the question, and both one-hop questions, right?
what_happened: Two-hop: says “Six” (right answer “Six”, P = 0.96). Hop 1 “Which insects make honey? Answer in one word.” → “Bees”. Hop 2 “How many legs does a bee have? Answer in one word.” → “Six”.

asks: Is every edited word a single token?
what_happened: “bee”, “bees” are single tokens.

asks: Does removing the answer's own direction kill it, and from which layers?
what_happened: Remove the answer “Six” itself: first kills it in layers 24–29 (P 0.96 → 0.11, drop 0.88). That's where the model starts writing the answer.

asks: In the one-hop question whose answer is the bridge, does removing it kill that answer (before the answer onset)?
what_happened: Ask “Which insects make honey? Answer in one word.” (model: “Bees”). Remove “bee” in layers 18–23 → P(“Bees”) goes 0.97 → 0.11. Drop 0.89.

asks: Does removing the bridge, before the answer onset, kill the answer?
what_happened: Remove “bee” in layers 0–5 → P(“Six”) goes 0.96 → 0.94. Drop 0.02.

asks: Is that drop bigger than removing everyday words of the same strength?
what_happened: Biggest drop from 12 everyday words: 0.03 (“garden”, layers 12–17). Bridge 0.02 − noise 0.03 = -0.01 (pass ≥ 0.5).

asks: Does the bridge start to matter at least 3 layers before the answer does?
what_happened: Removing “bee” never drops P by 0.5 in any window; the answer “Six” matters from layer 24.

asks: Does removing the bridge matter more than removing another word of its kind with the same answer?
what_happened: Remove “beetle” (same answer) → P(“Six”) goes 0.96 → 0.94. Drop 0.02. Bridge 0.02 − 0.02 = -0.00 (pass ≥ 0.3).

asks: Does the same edit leave unrelated questions alone?
what_happened: Same edit (layers 0–5): “What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer in one word.” → P(“Au”) 1.00 → 1.00; “What is the largest planet in the Solar System? Answer in one word.” → P(“Jupiter”) 0.95 → 0.89. Biggest drop 0.07 (pass ≤ 0.1).

asks: What if the bridge is removed over many layers at once?
what_happened: Remove “bee” in layers 8–23 → P(“Six”) 0.96 → 0.96 (drop 0.01); in all layers → 0.94 (drop 0.02).

asks: Does removing only the part of the bridge not shared with the answer still kill it?
what_happened: Remove “bee” minus “Six” (early layers) → P(“Six”) 0.96 → 0.94. Drop 0.02.

asks: Swap in another word: does the answer become that word's answer?
what_happened: 0 of 5 swaps gave the swapped word's own answer (fallback answer with the bridge removed: “6”).

asks: Swap in a word with the same answer: is the answer kept?
what_happened: 2 of 2 kept the answer.
